description: Refinery Throughput (Crude Oil and Feedstock)- Thousands of US Barrels is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Ministry of Oil and Environment. As crude oil is not typically used in its unrefined form, Bahrain field crude is blended with imported crude and other feedstocks to process a range of refined petroleum products. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Oil & Gas. Its keywords are Oil & Gas. The portal shows 27 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
